name: Love Pride
description:
Another reference to the LGBTQ+ pride movement in combination with a symbol used by Shortcut in 'Join the Church of Love'.

It describes the self-confident and thus proud handling of one's own sexual identity, being who one is and standing up for one's rights.

This is an Expansion Item for Forever Supper, the biggest cryptoart collaboration. Claim your free Core and customise it with the Expansions you collect here: https://async.market/dynamic-blueprints/63fe742c74e62000a8cf7bb8/async-forever-supper
